name: /about
details: Nationdex is a countryball/nation collector bot for Discord. Collect, trade, and compete with friends to see who can collect the most countryballs!

subcommands.name: balance
subcommands.description: View the amount of foils you have.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user to give foils to.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount of foils to give.

name: /help
details: Displays all available commands with their descriptions, categories, usage, and parameters. An interactive menu allows you to click through pages.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: The rarity class to view the leaderboard of.

subcommands.name: value
subcommands.description: View the leaderboard of total nations value.

subcommands.name: compare
subcommands.description: Compare your nations progress with another user.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user whom you want to compare to.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Compare the nations of a specific rarity class.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: The class whose nations to show.

subcommands.name: gift
subcommands.description: Gift a nation to another user.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user whom you want to gift.

parameters.name: nation
parameters.description: The nation you want to give.

parameters.name: nation
parameters.description: The nation to view the info card of.

subcommands.name: last
subcommands.description: View info of the last nation you caught.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user whose last nation to check.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: View info of the last nation you caught of a specific rarity class.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user whose nation progress to view.

parameters.name: nation
parameters.description: The nation you want to sell.

subcommands.name: settings
subcommands.description: View or customize your player settings.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: The rarity class whose nations' rarity to view.

subcommands.name: info
subcommands.description: View rarity info of a nation.

parameters.name: nation
parameters.description: The nation whose rarity info to view.

subcommands.name: channel
subcommands.description: Set a channel for nations to spawn in.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The channel to spawn nations in, leave empty to reset.

subcommands.name: toggle
subcommands.description: Toggle on/off nations spawning in the server.

subcommands.name: ping
subcommands.description: Test the bot's current API latency and gateway connection speeds.
subcommands.details: Useful for diagnostic checks if messages seem delayed or if Discord is experiencing performance issues.
